label.zh-TW: App Store：TalkMe（開發者網站為 talkme.ai）
label.en: App Store: TalkMe (developer website on talkme.ai)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（talkmeai.onelink.me，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (talkmeai.onelink.me; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示前往 App 商店的官方上架頁，確認開發者是 INSPIRED AI PTE. LTD. 後再安裝。
steps.en: Follow the page to the official app store listing, and install it only after checking the developer is INSPIRED AI PTE. LTD.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示註冊或登入。
steps.en: Open the app and register or log in as it directs.

intro.zh-TW: 練習英文口說的 AI App「TalkMe」的分享連結；沒有邀請碼，分享文案只提到免費使用。
intro.en: Share link for TalkMe, an AI app for practicing spoken English; no code, and the share text only mentions free use.

description.zh-TW:
TalkMe 是練習英文口說的 AI App，由 INSPIRED AI PTE. LTD. 發行，可免費下載，App 內有購買項目。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 OneLink 短網址（talkmeai.onelink.me），網址帶有邀請人編號，沒有邀請碼。分享文案只寫可透過連結免費使用，沒有說明具體優惠，所以不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
TalkMe is an AI app for practicing spoken English, published by INSPIRED AI PTE. LTD. It is free to download, and the app has in-app purchases.

The link on this page is the OneLink short link (talkmeai.onelink.me) from the share text; its address carries the referrer's ID and no invite code. The share text only says you can use the app for free through the link and describes no specific offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 連結原樣保留。talkmeai.onelink.me 屬於 AppsFlyer 的共用 OneLink 服務，只因網站規則要求才列入（只列完整主機），請不要把其他 onelink.me 網址當成 TalkMe 官方連結。2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 App Store 的 TalkMe 頁面（開發者網站為 talkme.ai）；手機上的轉址與邀請是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The link is kept exactly as shared. talkmeai.onelink.me belongs to AppsFlyer's shared OneLink service and is listed only because the site's rules require it (the full host only); do not treat other onelink.me links as TalkMe official links. Opened in a desktop browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the TalkMe App Store page (developer website talkme.ai); the mobile redirect and whether a referral is accepted were not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: TalkMe 的分享連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the TalkMe share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟；App 註冊時是否有邀請碼欄位沒有查證。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, so open the link on this page. Whether the app's sign-up has a code field was not checked.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結使用 TalkMe 有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for using TalkMe through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只寫可透過連結免費使用，沒有說明具體優惠；App Store 頁面只標示可免費下載、App 內有購買項目，所以不列優惠。
a.en: The share text only says you can use it for free through the link and describes no specific offer; the App Store page only shows a free download with in-app purchases, so no offer is listed.
